noAnchorGaps.concept: The C-clamp pinch ahead of price — the point where the two cloud spans squeeze together into a clamp-like launchpad with little holding price back
noAnchorGaps.quote: A C-clamp pinch ahead of price is often a launchpad: little is holding it back, so a break tends to be sharp and clean.
noAnchorGaps.why: move ichimoku exposes only pullback(pt) and aboveCloud(pt); there is no anchor at the point where the two spans squeeze together (no pinch/clamp/twist anchor), so the C-clamp launchpad cannot be drawn without inventing an anchor

notes: Single CHART beat ('chart', ichimoku). Both anchors (pullback, aboveCloud) are valid points for the note kind and are not drawn by the move itself.
